-- The guardian's body sets the movement volume. Ornaments can extend beyond it.
local GUARD_BODY_SIZE=Vector3.new(2.8,3.4,2.8)
local GUARD_BODY_OFFSET=Vector3.new(0,1.85,0)

local function clearGuardStep(at:Vector3,step:Vector3,ray:RaycastParams,overlap:OverlapParams):Vector3?
 local origin=CFrame.new(at+GUARD_BODY_OFFSET)
 local hit=workspace:Blockcast(origin,GUARD_BODY_SIZE,step,ray)
 if hit then
  -- Let an oblique move continue along the wall if its tangent is clear.
  local outward=Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X,0,hit.Normal.Z)
  if outward.Magnitude<.5 then return nil end
  outward=outward.Unit
  step-=outward*step:Dot(outward)
  if step.Magnitude<=.01 or workspace:Blockcast(origin,GUARD_BODY_SIZE,step,ray) then return nil end
 end
 -- A sweep does not report parts already intersecting its initial shape.
 -- Require a free end position so a short step cannot advance through them.
 if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(origin+step,GUARD_BODY_SIZE,overlap)>0 then return nil end
 return at+step
end

local ridgeVisuals:{[Instance]:{BasePart}}={}
local function reclaimRidgeForCastle(arena:Instance):boolean
 local bucket=ridgeVisuals[arena]
 if not bucket then return false end
 while #bucket>0 do
  local p=table.remove(bucket)
  if p and p.Parent then
   p:Destroy()
   budgets[arena]=math.max(0,(budgets[arena] or 0)-1)
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end
-- GQ470_FORTRESS_VISUAL_FAIR_BUDGET_REAL69_20261121
-- Reserve ten existing identity parts per castle, without increasing the
-- existing per-arena 320-Part limit or 19-Part optional castle detail limit.
local MIN_CASTLE_ESSENTIAL_PARTS = 10
-- Keep only this art author's instances; do not count gameplay geometry.
-- Old castles/other art can be removed during a match: prune stale references
-- before every new castle, so the counter never prevents later roofs/crests.
local trackedArt:{[Instance]:{BasePart}}={}
local function recountArenaArt(arena:Instance):{BasePart}
 local active:{BasePart}={}
 for _,p in ipairs(trackedArt[arena] or {}) do
  if p.Parent and p:IsDescendantOf(arena) then table.insert(active,p) end
 end
 trackedArt[arena]=active
 budgets[arena]=#active
 return active
end
local function reserveCastleIdentity(arena:Instance):boolean
 local active=recountArenaArt(arena)
 while #active+MIN_CASTLE_ESSENTIAL_PARTS>MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA do
  -- Reclaim only expendable decorations, NEVER a roof/keystone/crest.
  local optionalIndex:number?=nil
  for index=#active,1,-1 do
   if active[index]:GetAttribute("GQ470CastleOptional")==true then
    optionalIndex=index
    break
   end
  end
  if not optionalIndex then return false end
  local old=table.remove(active,optionalIndex)
  if old then old:Destroy() end
  budgets[arena]=#active
 end
 return true
end

if (budgets[arena] or 0)>=MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA then
  if parent.Name~="EGGRUMBLE_CastleArt_VisualOnly" or not reclaimRidgeForCastle(arena) then return nil end
 end

-- GQ470_FB015_RIDGE_HORIZON_P0_20261120
-- Visual-only horizon cliffs are strictly lower priority than all baseline
-- terrain/ruin visuals and every current or future castle ornament.
-- At most twelve noncolliding wedges; castles may reclaim them on budget hit.
local function drawHorizonRidges(arena:Instance,art:Instance,ground:(number,number)->Vector3)
 local bucket=ridgeVisuals[arena]
 -- A scene may be repainted; keep one bounded ridge set per arena, never 12 more.
 if bucket then return end
 bucket={}
 ridgeVisuals[arena]=bucket
 -- The arena teardown releases both its reference and decorative-Part list.
 arena.Destroying:Once(function()
  ridgeVisuals[arena]=nil
 end)
 -- Three unequal stepped profiles, mirrored by shore without repeating
 -- identical silhouettes. Each side has six matte, nonphysical Wedges.
 local ridgeContours = {
  {height=14,yaw=-19,drift=-16,depth=27,lean=-7,notch=3},
  {height=23,yaw=13,drift=8,depth=35,lean=6,notch=1},
  {height=17,yaw=27,drift=19,depth=25,lean=-4,notch=4},
 }
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  for index=1,3 do
   local contour=ridgeContours[index]
   local x=side*410
   local z=(index-2)*270+side*contour.drift
   local at=ground(x,z)
   local h=contour.height+(if side>0 then 3 else 0)
   local turn=side*contour.yaw
   local lean=side*contour.lean
   -- Use existing matte stone palette for subtle depth and directional
   -- contrast. These Color3 blends run once when an arena is built, not
   -- during combat frames; zero new instances or texture fetches.
   local baseTint=darkStone:Lerp(limestone,.07*(index-1))
   local crownTint=limestone:Lerp(darkStone,.08*(3-index))
   -- Reserve both pieces before sculpting a complete profile. If the 320
   -- scene cap is almost full, skip this pair rather than leave a bare wedge.
   if (budgets[arena] or 0)+2<=MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA then
    local basePart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffBase_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
     Vector3.new(18,h,contour.depth),
     CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(side*contour.notch,h/2,0))
      *CFrame.Angles(math.rad((index-2)*3),math.rad(turn),math.rad(lean)),
     baseTint,Enum.Material.Slate)
    if basePart then
     -- Matched limestone cap penetrates the base: no detached floating crown.
     local crownPart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffCrown_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
      Vector3.new(11,4,contour.depth-6),
      CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(-side*(2+contour.notch*.25),h+.75,side*2))
       *CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-lean),math.rad(-turn*.7),math.rad(-lean*1.4)),
      crownTint,Enum.Material.Limestone)
     if crownPart then
      table.insert(bucket,basePart)
      table.insert(bucket,crownPart)
     else
      -- Defensive rollback for a failed crown allocation; no half cliff.
      basePart:Destroy()
      budgets[arena]=math.max(0,(budgets[arena] or 0)-1)
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

-- Match world replacement must release per-arena accounting references.
 arena.Destroying:Connect(function()
  builtArenas[arena]=nil
  budgets[arena]=nil
  trackedArt[arena]=nil
 end)

-- GQ470_FB015_RIDGE_HORIZON_P0_20261120: add only after baseline and present castles.
 drawHorizonRidges(arena,art,onGround)

 -- Real server-confirmed KO only. Two solid asymmetrical 3D slash fins
 -- replace one expanding Neon sphere; no light, particles, Remote or audio.
 -- Original six-KOs-per-second budget applies to the whole two-fin burst.
 -- Art orientation follows horizontal victim facing; no camera-facing HUD.
 if not world.Parent or not target.PrimaryPart then return false end
 -- A fixed-second rate limiter alone permits two overlapping bursts of six
 -- around a second boundary. Reclaim only fully removed pairs (Debris or
 -- arena teardown); a single remaining fin still occupies the burst slot.
 for i=#liveKOBursts,1,-1 do
  local live=false
  for _,fin in ipairs(liveKOBursts[i]) do
   if fin.Parent then live=true;break end
  end
  if not live then table.remove(liveKOBursts,i) end
 end
 if #liveKOBursts>=MAX_LIVE_KO_BURSTS or not budget(true) then return false end
 local pivot=target.PrimaryPart.CFrame
 local at=pivot.Position
 local flatLook=Vector3.new(pivot.LookVector.X,0,pivot.LookVector.Z)
 if flatLook.Magnitude<.001 then flatLook=Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
 local burstFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+flatLook.Unit)
 local accent=colors[role] or colors.WARRIOR
 local burst:{BasePart}={}
 table.insert(liveKOBursts,burst)
 for side=-1,1,2 do
  local fin=Instance.new("WedgePart")
  fin.Name="EGGRUMBLE_KO_BURST"
  fin.Size=Vector3.new(.34,1.65,.44)
  fin.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
  fin.Anchored=true;fin.CanCollide=false;fin.CanTouch=false
  fin.CanQuery=false;fin.CastShadow=false
  fin.Color=if side==1 then accent else Color3.fromRGB(245,245,235)
  fin.Transparency=.12
  fin.CFrame=burstFrame*CFrame.new(side*.38,1.0,0)
   *CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(side*28),math.rad(side*37))
  table.insert(burst,fin)
  fin.Parent=world
  local endAt=fin.CFrame*CFrame.new(side*.74,.7,0)
  local tween=TweenService:Create(
   fin,TweenInfo.new(.23,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
   {Size=Vector3.new(.8,3.5,.28),CFrame=endAt})
  -- Leave time for both fins to replicate before fading the KO confirmation.
  local fade=TweenService:Create(
   fin,TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,.31),
   {Transparency=1})
  tween:Play()
  fade:Play()
  Debris:AddItem(fin,.53)
 end

 -- replace one expanding Neon sphere; no light, particles, Remote or audio.

 -- Art orientation follows horizontal victim facing; no camera-facing HUD.
 if not world.Parent or not target.PrimaryPart then return false end
 -- A fixed-second rate limiter alone permits two overlapping bursts of six
 -- around a second boundary. Reclaim only fully removed pairs (Debris or
 -- arena teardown); a single remaining fin still occupies the burst slot.
 for i=#liveKOBursts,1,-1 do
  local live=false
  for _,fin in ipairs(liveKOBursts[i]) do
   if fin.Parent then live=true;break end
  end
  if not live then table.remove(liveKOBursts,i) end
 end
 if #liveKOBursts>=MAX_LIVE_KO_BURSTS or not budget(true) then return false end
 local pivot=target.PrimaryPart.CFrame
 local at=pivot.Position
 local flatLook=Vector3.new(pivot.LookVector.X,0,pivot.LookVector.Z)
 if flatLook.Magnitude<.001 then flatLook=Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
 local burstFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+flatLook.Unit)
 local accent=colors[role] or colors.WARRIOR
 local burst:{BasePart}={}
 table.insert(liveKOBursts,burst)
 for side=-1,1,2 do

-- Host availability and its transport order belong to the server. Apply the
-- local view through separate properties, without writing a peer's Enabled.
local peers = game:GetService("Players")
local roundAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationRoundV1"
local teamAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationTeam"
local readyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReady"
local heightAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationHeight"
local rayLift = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true

type Viewer = { character: Model, root: BasePart, round: number, team: string }
type Peer = {
	carrier: Player,
	character: Model,
	root: BasePart,
	prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	range: number,
	enabledChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	readyChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	seen: number,
}
local tracked: { [ProximityPrompt]: Peer } = {}

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

refreshPeerRelays()
local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	elapsed += deltaTime
	if elapsed < 0.125 then return end
	elapsed = 0
	refreshPeerRelays()
end)

end)

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

  -- Let an oblique move continue along the wall if its tangent is clear.
  local outward=Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X,0,hit.Normal.Z)
  if outward.Magnitude<.5 then return nil end

  if step.Magnitude<=.01 or workspace:Blockcast(origin,GUARD_BODY_SIZE,step,ray) then return nil end

 -- Require a free end position so a short step cannot advance through them.

	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt

	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"

	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end

	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return

	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)

	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team

		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position

			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }

			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide

	end
	present(binding, visible)

	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end

	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

type Viewer = { character: Model, root: BasePart, round: number, team: string }
type Peer = {

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)

	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)

	return root, prompt

	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

refreshPeerRelays()
local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)

	refreshPeerRelays()

-- GQ470_FB015_ROLE_MOTION_READABLE_REAL69_20261121: visual-only timing.
-- A modest anticipation, crisp strike, brief impact silhouette and smooth recovery
-- make 7 job gestures readable without new parts, tweens, remotes or frame loops.
-- Normalized time is server-cast-driven; no server damage/skill timing changes.
local function smoothstep(t:number):number
 local x=math.clamp(t,0,1)
 return x*x*(3-2*x)
end
local function motionProfile(t:number,slot:string):(number,number)
 local u=math.clamp(t,0,1)
 -- Skill A is only 0.26s: its old 0.12*duration=31ms hold may be skipped at 25fps.
 -- Extend just A's impact silhouette to 0.26*0.26s=67.6ms (mobile-friendly).
 -- Longer B/C skills keep their previous pacing without changing server timing.
 local strikeEnd=(slot=="A") and .36 or .42
 local holdEnd=(slot=="A") and .62 or .54
 if u<.18 then
  return -.20*smoothstep(u/.18),0
 elseif u<strikeEnd then
  local strike=smoothstep((u-.18)/(strikeEnd-.18))
  return -.20+1.20*strike,strike
 elseif u<holdEnd then
  return 1,1
 else
  local recover=1-smoothstep((u-holdEnd)/(1-holdEnd))
  return recover,recover
 end
end

local function vec(x, y, z)
    return {X = x, Y = y, Z = z}
end
local function matrixProduct(a, b)
    local result = {}
    for row = 0, 2 do
        for col = 1, 3 do
            result[row * 3 + col] = a[row * 3 + 1] * b[col]
                + a[row * 3 + 2] * b[3 + col] + a[row * 3 + 3] * b[6 + col]
        end
    end
    return result
end
local identity = {1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}
local function transform(a, p)
    return vec(a[1]*p.X+a[2]*p.Y+a[3]*p.Z, a[4]*p.X+a[5]*p.Y+a[6]*p.Z, a[7]*p.X+a[8]*p.Y+a[9]*p.Z)
end
local frameMethods = {}
local function frame(p, r)
    return setmetatable({p = p, r = r}, frameMethods)
end
frameMethods.__mul = function(a, b)
    local p = transform(a.r, b.p)
    return frame(vec(a.p.X+p.X, a.p.Y+p.Y, a.p.Z+p.Z), matrixProduct(a.r,b.r))
end
local function angles(x, y, z)
    local cx, sx = math.cos(x), math.sin(x)
    local cy, sy = math.cos(y), math.sin(y)
    local cz, sz = math.cos(z), math.sin(z)
    local rx = {1,0,0,0,cx,-sx,0,sx,cx}
    local ry = {cy,0,sy,0,1,0,-sy,0,cy}
    local rz = {cz,-sz,0,sz,cz,0,0,0,1}
    return frame(vec(0,0,0), matrixProduct(matrixProduct(rx,ry),rz))
end
local function instance(kind)
    local object = {Name = kind, ClassName = kind, children = {}, attrs = {}}
    function object:IsA(class)
        return class==kind or (class=="BasePart" and (kind=="Part" or kind=="WedgePart"))
    end
    function object:FindFirstChild(name)
        for _, child in ipairs(self.children) do
            if child.Name==name and child.Parent==self then return child end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function object:Destroy()
        for _, child in ipairs(self.children) do child:Destroy() end
        self.Parent = false
    end
    function object:SetAttribute(name, value)
        self.attrs[name] = value
    end
    return setmetatable(object, {__newindex = function(self, key, value)
        if key=="Parent" and value then table.insert(value.children, self) end
        rawset(self, key, value)
    end})
end
local env = setmetatable({
    CFrame = {
        new = function(x,y,z) return frame(vec(x,y,z),identity) end,
        Angles = angles,
    },
    Vector3 = {new = vec},
    Color3 = {fromRGB = function(r,g,b) return {r,g,b} end},
    Enum = {Material = {Metal = "Metal", Neon = "Neon"}, PartType = {Block = "Block", Cylinder = "Cylinder"}},
    Instance = {new = instance},
}, {__index = getfenv()})
local roleCases = {
    {"WARRIOR",5}, {"MAGE",4}, {"NINJA",5}, {"TRAPPER",4}, {"BUILDER",5}, {"BEAST",4}, {"ZOMBIE",5},
}
local function scan(version, source)
    local evaluated = assert(loadstring(source))
    setfenv(evaluated,env)
    local weapons = evaluated()
    local total = 0
    for _, case in ipairs(roleCases) do
        local role,num = case[1],case[2]
        local character = instance("Model")
        local grip = instance("Part")

        grip.CFrame = frame(vec(0,0,0),identity)
        grip.Parent = character
        local player = {Character = character}

        local first = assert(character:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_ClassWeapon"))
        assert(not weapons.attach(player,"UNKNOWN") and first.Parent==character)
        grip.Name = "Right Arm"
        assert(weapons.attach(player,role))
        assert(first.Parent==false)
        local selected = assert(character:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_ClassWeapon"))
        assert(selected.attrs.Role==role and selected.attrs.VisualParts==num and #selected.children==num)

	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end

--!strict
-- Local presentation for the private Studio match. The server owns relay eligibility.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local relayName = "EGGRUMBLE_ClassicEggRelay"
type CharacterWatch = {
	character: Model,
	added: RBXScriptConnection?,
	removing: RBXScriptConnection?,
	relays: { [ProximityPrompt]: RBXScriptConnection },
}
local current: CharacterWatch?

local function clearCharacter()
	local old = current
	if not old then return end
	current = nil
	if old.added then old.added:Disconnect() end
	if old.removing then old.removing:Disconnect() end
	for _, connection in pairs(old.relays) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
end

local function watchCharacter(character: Model)
	if player.Character ~= character or (current and current.character == character) then return end
	clearCharacter()
	local watch: CharacterWatch = {character = character, added = nil, removing = nil, relays = {}}
	current = watch

	local function consider(instance: Instance)
		if not instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or instance.Name ~= relayName then return end
		local root = instance.Parent
		if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or root.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" or root.Parent ~= character then return end
		if watch.relays[instance] then return end

		local function hideOwnRelay()
			if current == watch and player.Character == character
				and instance.Parent == root and root.Parent == character and instance.Enabled then
				instance.Enabled = false
			end
		end
		watch.relays[instance] = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(hideOwnRelay)
		hideOwnRelay()
	end

	watch.added = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(consider)
	watch.removing = character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
		if not instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return end
		local connection = watch.relays[instance]
		if not connection then return end
		watch.relays[instance] = nil
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
	for _, instance in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		consider(instance)
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
	if current and current.character == character then
		clearCharacter()
	end
end)
if player.Character then
	watchCharacter(player.Character)
end

-- Host availability and its transport order belong to the server. Apply the
-- local view through separate properties, without writing a peer's Enabled.
local peers = game:GetService("Players")
local roundAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationRoundV1"
local teamAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationTeam"
local readyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReady"
local heightAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationHeight"
local receiverReadyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReceiverReady"
local rayLift = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true

type Viewer = { character: Model, root: BasePart, round: number, team: string }
type Peer = {
	carrier: Player,
	character: Model,
	root: BasePart,
	prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	range: number,
	enabledChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	readyChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	seen: number,
}
local tracked: { [ProximityPrompt]: Peer } = {}

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt or prompt:GetAttribute(receiverReadyAttribute) ~= true then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end

end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()

	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

	elapsed = 0

end)

-- Host availability and its transport order belong to the server. Apply the
-- local view through separate properties, without writing a peer's Enabled.
local peers = game:GetService("Players")
local roundAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationRoundV1"
local teamAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationTeam"
local readyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReady"
local heightAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationHeight"
local receiverReadyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReceiverReady"
local rayLift = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true

type Viewer = { character: Model, root: BasePart, round: number, team: string }
type Peer = {
	carrier: Player,
	character: Model,
	root: BasePart,
	prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	range: number,
	enabledChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	readyChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	seen: number,
}
local tracked: { [ProximityPrompt]: Peer } = {}

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt or prompt:GetAttribute(receiverReadyAttribute) ~= true then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function separateAttackFromJump(anchors,jump,w,h)

  return x+half+gap>rect.left and x-half-gap<rect.right

  if name=="ATTACK" or name=="JUMP" then continue end
  local extent=other.size*.5
  table.insert(obstacles,{left=other.x-extent,top=other.y-extent,right=other.x+extent,bottom=other.y+extent})

  if x-half<0 or y-half<0 or x+half>w or y+half>h then return false end

  table.insert(xs,rect.right+half+gap)
  table.insert(ys,rect.top-half-gap)
  table.insert(ys,rect.bottom+half+gap)

local function separateAttackFromJump(anchors,jump,w,h)
 if not jump then return end
 local attack=anchors.ATTACK
 local half=attack.size*.5
 local gap=5
 local function intersects(x,y,rect)
  return x+half+gap>rect.left and x-half-gap<rect.right
   and y+half+gap>rect.top and y-half-gap<rect.bottom
 end
 if not intersects(attack.x,attack.y,jump) then return end
 local left,right=jump.left-half-gap,jump.right+half+gap
 local above,below=jump.top-half-gap,jump.bottom+half+gap

  {attack.x,above},{left,attack.y},{right,attack.y},{attack.x,below},
  {left,above},{right,above},{left,below},{right,below},
 }

  if name=="ATTACK" or name=="JUMP" then continue end
  local extent=other.size*.5
  table.insert(obstacles,{left=other.x-extent,top=other.y-extent,right=other.x+extent,bottom=other.y+extent})
 end
 local function clearAt(x,y)
  if x-half<0 or y-half<0 or x+half>w or y+half>h then return false end
  for _,rect in ipairs(obstacles) do
   if intersects(x,y,rect) then return false end
  end
  return true
 end

  local x,y=spot[1],spot[2]
  if clearAt(x,y) then
   attack.x,attack.y=x,y
   return
  end
 end
 if w<2*half or h<2*half then return end
 -- If the authored nearby positions are full, the closest free centre lies
 -- on an edge of an expanded control or on a safe-area boundary.
 local xs={math.clamp(attack.x,half,w-half),half,w-half}
 local ys={math.clamp(attack.y,half,h-half),half,h-half}
 for _,rect in ipairs(obstacles) do
  table.insert(xs,rect.left-half-gap)
  table.insert(xs,rect.right+half+gap)
  table.insert(ys,rect.top-half-gap)
  table.insert(ys,rect.bottom+half+gap)
 end
 local bestX,bestY,bestDistance=attack.x,attack.y,math.huge
 for _,x in ipairs(xs) do
  for _,y in ipairs(ys) do
   local distance=(x-attack.x)^2+(y-attack.y)^2
   if (distance<bestDistance or (distance==bestDistance and (y<bestY or (y==bestY and x<bestX))))
    and clearAt(x,y) then

   end
  end
 end

	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else
			-- Outside the scene it is safe to restore the original range before
			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

refreshPeerRelays()
local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	elapsed += deltaTime
	if elapsed < 0.125 then return end
	elapsed = 0
	refreshPeerRelays()
end)

 local touchGui=playerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")

 local controls=touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")

 local jump=controls and controls:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")

 local size=jump.AbsoluteSize
 if size.X<=0 or size.Y<=0 then return end
 return jump.AbsolutePosition-gui.AbsolutePosition,size
end

local function separateAttackFromJump(anchors,jump,w,h)
 if not jump then return end
 local attack=anchors.ATTACK
 local half=attack.size*.5
 local gap=5
 local function intersects(x,y,rect)
  return x+half+gap>rect.left and x-half-gap<rect.right
   and y+half+gap>rect.top and y-half-gap<rect.bottom
 end
 if not intersects(attack.x,attack.y,jump) then return end
 local left,right=jump.left-half-gap,jump.right+half+gap
 local above,below=jump.top-half-gap,jump.bottom+half+gap
 local nearby={
  {attack.x,above},{left,attack.y},{right,attack.y},{attack.x,below},
  {left,above},{right,above},{left,below},{right,below},
 }
 local obstacles={jump}
 for name,other in pairs(anchors) do
  if name=="ATTACK" or name=="JUMP" then continue end
  local extent=other.size*.5
  table.insert(obstacles,{left=other.x-extent,top=other.y-extent,right=other.x+extent,bottom=other.y+extent})
 end
 local function clearAt(x,y)
  if x-half<0 or y-half<0 or x+half>w or y+half>h then return false end
  for _,rect in ipairs(obstacles) do
   if intersects(x,y,rect) then return false end
  end
  return true
 end
 for _,spot in ipairs(nearby) do
  local x,y=spot[1],spot[2]
  if clearAt(x,y) then
   attack.x,attack.y=x,y
   return
  end
 end
 if w<2*half or h<2*half then return end
 -- If the authored nearby positions are full, the closest free centre lies
 -- on an edge of an expanded control or on a safe-area boundary.
 local xs={math.clamp(attack.x,half,w-half),half,w-half}
 local ys={math.clamp(attack.y,half,h-half),half,h-half}
 for _,rect in ipairs(obstacles) do
  table.insert(xs,rect.left-half-gap)
  table.insert(xs,rect.right+half+gap)
  table.insert(ys,rect.top-half-gap)
  table.insert(ys,rect.bottom+half+gap)
 end
 local bestX,bestY,bestDistance=attack.x,attack.y,math.huge
 for _,x in ipairs(xs) do
  for _,y in ipairs(ys) do
   local distance=(x-attack.x)^2+(y-attack.y)^2
   if (distance<bestDistance or (distance==bestDistance and (y<bestY or (y==bestY and x<bestX))))
    and clearAt(x,y) then
    bestX,bestY,bestDistance=x,y,distance
   end
  end
 end
 attack.x,attack.y=bestX,bestY
end
